name: Hepatitis C
overview: Hepatitis C is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: In routine practice, hepatitis C is an infectious disease caused by the hepatitis C virus (HCV) that primarily affects the liver.
In routine practice, during the initial infection period, people often have mild or no symptoms.

faq.question: What should I do if Hepatitis C symptoms worsen suddenly?
